text: Ask the built-in assistant Ari plain-language finance questions, such as whether you can afford a hire, why spending rose, or how long cash lasts
quote: Ask it whether you can afford to hire, why spending went up, or how long your cash lasts.

text: Ari answers by building a financial Model that you can open to check every number and change the assumptions yourself
quote: Ari answers by building and updating a financial Model of your business, and you can open that Model, check every number, and change the assumptions yourself.

text: Import actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet
quote: Bring in Actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or Rillet.

text: Ari connects to your ledger, bank, and payroll to keep one current model of the company
quote: Ari connects to your ledger, bank and payroll, keeps one model of the company current, and tells you what changed before you ask.

text: Ari rebuilds an existing spreadsheet workbook as a live Model and checks that it ties out
quote: Have Ari rebuild your workbook as a live Model, then check that it ties.

text: Forecast revenue, costs, and cash from the drivers of your business
quote: Forecast revenue, costs, and cash from what drives your business.

text: See the impact of a hire, a price change, or a cost cut before committing
quote: See what a hire, a price change, or a cut does before you commit.

text: Create scenarios from a one-line request, such as a hire wave, a slipped quarter, or a downside case, including several at once
quote: Scenarios you ask for in one line: a hire wave, a slipped quarter, a downside growth case, several at once.

text: Unlimited models and scenarios
quote: MCP server and Slack app · Proactive alerts & triggers · Unlimited models & scenarios

text: Share a read-only report link with investors or the board
quote: Send investors or your board a read-only link to a report.

text: Download a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas
quote: Download a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas.

text: Build tables by hand and write formulas in a spreadsheet-like way
quote: For spreadsheet users: build a small table by hand and write a formula.

text: Board decks are drafted automatically from the previous night's numbers, built on the model
quote: Board and investor work that starts before you do: a deck drafted off last night's numbers, on the model rather than in a thread.

text: Every figure traces its lineage back to the source line
quote: Each one prints its lineage back to the source line. Every write is undoable, and anything it cannot verify it declines to sign.

text: Ari declines to sign off on anything it cannot verify
quote: Each one prints its lineage back to the source line. Every write is undoable, and anything it cannot verify it declines to sign.

text: Ari keeps the model current and proactively messages you when something moves, with alerts and triggers
quote: Ari builds the model and keeps it current, then messages you when something moves rather than waiting to be asked.

text: The live model is rebuilt overnight from the close instead of relying on manual spreadsheet updates
quote: One live model of the company, rebuilt overnight off the close, instead of a spreadsheet that is accurate on the day someone last had time to update it.

text: Upload CSV exports, such as bank transactions or reports from unsupported systems, as a first-class source that feeds the Model
quote: Upload a CSV export, such as bank transactions or a report from a system cfo.ai does not connect to, so its rows feed your Model.

text: Connect a Google Sheet or a Drive Excel/CSV file; Ari imports it and updates the Model when the file changes
quote: Connect a Google Sheet, or an Excel or CSV file in Google Drive, so Ari imports it into your Model and updates the Model when the file changes.

text: Connect payroll/HR systems (Gusto, Rippling), CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce), Stripe, or a database so Ari plans from your records
quote: Connect Gusto, Rippling, or another payroll or HR system, HubSpot or Salesforce, Stripe, or a database so Ari plans from your records.

text: Connect data from a Snowflake warehouse
quote: Snowflake: Connect the data in your Snowflake warehouse.

text: Stop a running sync, re-import past months after fixing your books, and change a connection's nightly refresh time
quote: stop a running sync, re-import past months after you fix them in your books, and change the time a connection refreshes each night.

text: Trigger an immediate sync of QuickBooks or another source with Sync now or by asking Ari
quote: Sync QuickBooks or another connected source now with Sync now or by asking Ari, stop a running sync

text: Choose which tables a database or app syncs, and ask Ari to add or remove tables later
quote: Pick the tables a database or app syncs when you connect it, then ask Ari to add or remove tables later, such as syncing one more table from Postgres

text: Official MCP server lets AI clients like Claude Code and Codex work on your Model
quote: AI clients such as Claude Code and Codex can work on your Model through the cfo.ai MCP server.

text: Add cfo.ai as a custom connector in Claude desktop and claude.ai
quote: Claude's desktop app and claude.ai add outside servers as custom connectors. On a Claude Free, Pro, or Max plan, you add the connector yourself

text: External agents can read the Model and, on request, edit Pages, Table/Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables, and Dimensions
quote: an agent can read a company's financial Model and, when the user asks, change it: Pages, Table blocks, Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables, Dimensions

text: Agents can hand questions to Ari via edit_chats and read Ari's answers via inspect_chats
quote: An agent can also hand a question to Ari: `edit_chats` starts or continues an Ari chat and `inspect_chats` reads Ari's answer.

text: Every Model change is recorded in a changelog under the user's name and can be undone
quote: Every change to the Model, such as a formula, a Table block, or a Page edit, is recorded in the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone.

text: Agent tools run under a per-tool allow, ask, or deny policy with human approval
quote: runs under a per-tool allow, ask, or deny policy with human approval.

text: No API keys are issued; clients authenticate via browser-approved OAuth and act as the signed-in person
quote: cfo.ai issues no API keys or access tokens to copy; every client signs in as a person and acts as that person.

text: Agent setup through a skill.md file you paste into Claude Code, Codex, or another agent
quote: Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, or your preferred agent: set up https://cfo.ai/skill.md

text: Slack app integration
quote: MCP server and Slack app · Proactive alerts & triggers · Unlimited models & scenarios

text: Advisors get a separate workspace per client, each with a model Ari keeps current
quote: Every client gets its own workspace and a model Ari keeps current, so your hours go to advising.

text: In-app Help center opened with a keyboard shortcut
quote: Press ⌘ ? (Ctrl ? on Windows and Linux) in the app to open the Help center.
